title: PageBackendFilterExpression
description: Server-enforced filter expression for an entity page. A single condition or a nested and/or group tree that is always applied by the backend and cannot be removed by the client.
markdownDescription: AI guidance: use `backendFilter` for tenant, ownership, role, or workflow scoping that must not be user-editable. The root is either one condition or a group with `items`. Inside a group the first item has no `logic`; every following item must set `logic` to `and` or `or` to combine with the previous items. A condition names a `propertyName`, an explicit `operator` (never `default`), and exactly one value source: a static `value`, a `valueProvider` name registered in `AbpLowCodePageBackendFilterOptions` (for example `CurrentUserId`, `CurrentUserRoles`, `CurrentTenantId`), or a `javaScript` expression. `isNull`/`isNotNull` need no value; `hasValue` takes a boolean value; `between` takes two values; `in`/`notIn` take an array.

logic.description: How this item combines with the previous items of the same group.

operator.description: Filter operator. Must be explicit; 'default' is not allowed for backend filters. 'equals' is accepted as an alias of 'equal'.

propertyName.description: Property on the page entity to filter.

value.description: Static filter value. Use an array for in/notIn, two values for between, and true/false for hasValue.

valueProvider.description: Name of a registered backend filter value provider, for example 'CurrentUserId' or 'CurrentUserRoles'.

javaScript.description: JavaScript expression evaluated on the server to produce the filter value.

items.description: Ordered child conditions and groups. The first item has no logic; later items require logic.
